en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Al Hassan, and someone else from Sahl Bin Ziyad, by his chain, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘When one of you is free from his Ablution (Wudhu), so let him take a handful of water, so let him wipe his wrist for that would happen to be the freedom of his neck from the Fire’.
en.sarwar: 11. Muhammad ibn al-Hassan and others have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad through the chain of his narrators who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
When anyone of you completes his Wudu’, he must take water in his palm and wipe with it his back; it will free his neck from the fire.’” (This perhaps is because of Taqiyah)
